Abraham Augustine Norrsken VC Agate Freimane General partner Agate is a founding General Partner at Norrsken VC.
She started her career in finance working in investment banking and private equity at Citigroup and Morgan Stanley in London and New York.
She then started her start-up journey and was one of the first employees at BrickVest, a London based fintech start-up.
In her free time she is most passionate about education and co-founded Bright Mentors, an edtech charity in London.

Agate Freimane Norrsken VC Agnes Svensson Chief Impact Officer Agnes Svensson, Chief Impact Officer at Norrsken VC, brings over 12 years of experience, notably at Klarna, driving sustainability, diversity, and inclusion.
Agnes Svensson Norrsken Foundation Alexander Bardack Head of Investor Partnerships Alexander Bardack Norrsken VC Alexander Danielsson Partner Alexander Danielsson serves as a Partner at Norrsken VC.
Having honed his expertise in private equity during his tenure at TA Associates, Alexander possesses extensive insights into B2B SaaS.
His passion lies in championing visionary founders across the UK, Ireland and Nordics in the realm of climate technology.
